Outline · not written yet

This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 60 minutes when written.

16.1 · Three tiers

fast deterministic checks, a sampled model-graded suite, a full nightly run.

16.2 · Thresholds with error bars

fail on a significant regression, not on noise.

16.3 · Flaky evals

find them, quarantine them, and keep the gate trusted.

16.4 · Cost of an eval run

caching responses, sampling the suite, and budgeting judge calls.

16.5 · Snapshot testing for prompts

diffs a reviewer can read.

What you build

A CI gate (GitHub Actions) that runs a tiered suite and blocks significant regressions. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
